understanding: Clock period coverage samples observed wb_clk_i spec CLK edges with one symbolic fixed period P_fixed per test started before reset and held through traffic; raw period sampling is supported, band boundary stratum classification deferred until documented bands defined with no invented bounds or dynamic switching.
preconditions: DUT clock input wb_clk_i spec CLK available f_clk_1
DUT reset input wb_rst_i spec WB_RST_I available as asynchronous reset f_reset_1
Symbolic fixed period P_fixed selected per test as testbench infrastructure choice started before reset and held fixed through traffic
No DOCUMENTED band boundary or stratum limits assumed
stimulus_steps: START clock on wb_clk_i with symbolic period P_fixed before reset
ASSERT reset via wb_rst_i at symbolic active level R_ACTIVE then DEASSERT before traffic with duration scaled to P_fixed by symbolic count N_RST
HOLD clock period at P_fixed through traffic with no dynamic change or jitter injection
WAIT for traffic activity to provide sampleable clock edges
coverage_steps: SAMPLE observed clock edges on wb_clk_i and MEASURE sampled period P_sampled per observation window
SAMPLE raw period P_sampled with P_fixed and test seed without inventing band boundary or stratum
IF documented band map with boundary and low middle high strata becomes available THEN COMPARE P_sampled to that map ELSE retain P_sampled raw for later classification
SAMPLE per-test fixed-period context without claiming exhaustive coverage
completion: WAIT for traffic done OR TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES operational limit; timeout is testbench operational limit not DUT timing
STOP sampling and retain P_fixed with P_sampled and test seed for this test then CLEANUP to idle without mid-test period change

facts.statement: Spec CLK is 1-bit input block clock mapped to RTL wb_clk_i
Spec WB_RST_I is 1-bit input asynchronous reset mapped to RTL wb_rst_i

questions: What are documented CLK period bands and Max Min Resolution meanings for 1258Mhz for 1200 bps and 3.6864 for 115200 bps points?
What is nominal CLK frequency and period to use as P_fixed?
What are minimum and maximum operating CLK frequencies periods plus duty-cycle and jitter tolerance?
Is dynamic period change during operation permitted or must period stay fixed per test changed only between tests before reset and traffic?
What is active level polarity of wb_rst_i and required reset duration in CLK cycles for scaling to P_fixed?
